images.title: Angles along each slanted side add to 180°
images.purpose: Shows trapezium PQRS with PQ parallel to SR: ∠P = 70° and ∠S = 110° along one slanted side, ∠Q = 55° and ∠R = 125° along the other.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large trapezium in the centre with its parallel sides marked and its four angles labelled in two colour pairs.
images.exact_structure: One trapezium PQRS in dark outline: PQ the long horizontal bottom side, P bottom left and Q bottom right; SR a shorter horizontal top side, S top left and R top right. PQ and SR each carry one small dark arrowhead showing they are parallel. The left side PS makes 70° with PQ; the right side QR makes 55° with PQ, so QR slopes more gently than PS. Angle arcs: at P a teal (#0072B2) arc labelled 70°, at S a teal arc labelled 110°; at Q an amber (#E69F00) arc labelled 55°, at R an amber arc labelled 125°. The letters P, Q, R, S sit outside their corners. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In a trapezium the two angles along each slanted side add up to 180°.
images.description: Shows trapezium PQRS with PQ parallel to SR: ∠P = 70° and ∠S = 110° along one slanted side, ∠Q = 55° and ∠R = 125° along the other.

image_decisions.why: Colouring each pair of angles along a slanted side makes the 180° pairing obvious.
